dsDescriptionValue.value: The database contains time-series on maritime (sea-borne) and continental (hinterland) througput in the port of Antwerp. Also, data on shipping movements, infrastructure and superstructure of the Antwerp port have been included. The database was composed in the framework of a Ph.D. on functional shifts in the port of Antwerp.  Website where data set is available:  http://www.econ.kuleuven.ac.be/ew/academic/econhist/ [not accessible, 13-11-2019]
